purpose: One-file viewable comparative editorial candidate gallery, no approval or master edits
provenance: All exact original source bytes archived in earlier B38/B43/B44 draft Releases. Preview remotely loads institution/Commons image URLs; no downloaded image binaries embedded or rearchived.
reuse_rights_definition: Owner provided CC0/public-domain image qualifies for separate review; it does not permit attaching a different work to a frozen title without an explicit editorial decision.

items.title: The Holy Trinity
items.institution: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp
items.best_use: Possible original-object selection for the Rubens Trinity entry
items.merit: Exact owner-object identity and an exceptionally high-resolution original already preserved. Source painting's accession is unambiguous.
items.limitation: The frozen unreviewed record never specified KMSKA 314, so adopting it as that record's intended object requires a distinct editorial decision.

items.title: Joan of Arc
items.provider_rights: Met original marked public domain (Open Access)
items.best_use: Narrative of Joan of Arc hearing the saints' voices
items.merit: Specific narrative subject, large original and established art-historical provenance.
items.limitation: Not Eugène Carrière's RF3946; 19th-century naturalist style differs from a darker Baroque painting.

items.title: The Holy Family with Saints Anne, Joachim, and John the Baptist (presentation sketch)
items.best_use: Classical Catholic Holy Family with Saint Anne devotional art
items.merit: Authentic Catholic Roman commission context; soft classical figural grouping and exact theological-family subject.
items.limitation: It is Trevisani's presentation sketch, not any Rubens Holy Family version, and may differ from preferred dark palette.

items.title: Scenes from the Life of Saint Augustine of Hippo
items.medium: Oil, gold and silver on wood
items.provider_rights: Met original marked public domain (Open Access)
items.best_use: Long-form saint life, episcopal and historical liturgical narrative
items.merit: Five distinct episodes, vestments and altar implements with serious medieval Catholic provenance.
items.limitation: Not Prado P001314. Multi-scene composition may be too detailed for a small saint-card portrait.

items.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Denis
items.medium: Illuminated breviary leaf; tempera on vellum
items.best_use: Historical devotional manuscript and martyrdom narrative
items.merit: Documented late-medieval Christian illuminated manuscript, high-resolution original.
items.limitation: A manuscript miniature, not the frozen Baronne Girod de l'Ain canvas or a Baroque oil painting.

items.title: Icon of the New Testament Trinity
items.medium: Tempera and gold on wood panel
items.merit: Historically documented Orthodox iconography, independently CC0 and photographically preserved.
items.limitation: Depicts the 'New Testament Trinity' with God the Father and Christ seated; Orthodox templon origin, different iconographic register from a Latin Catholic devotional primary image. Requires careful doctrinal/editorial evaluation.
